items.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
items.summary: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

items.title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
items.summary: The artificial intelligence company disclosed more than $16 billion in revenue and an $80 billion net loss for the first half of 2026.

items.title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
items.summary: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

items.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
items.summary: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

items.title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
items.summary: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

items.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
items.summary: Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.

items.title: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court
items.summary: The agreement, which follows similar deals with MLB and NHL, establishes information-sharing to guard against insider trading as sports betting migrates to CFTC-regulated venues.

items.title: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
items.summary: Police in Seoul say a 32-year-old with no IT background used AI tools to break into about 90 hospitals, schools and companies, then pressed victims for roughly $270,000 combined.

items.title: AI Agents Found a Way Into Anthropic's Business Systems in Under 12 Hours
items.summary: Cathedral, a startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says its AI agents found paths into Anthropic's sales, HR, and IT systems through third-party software.

items.title: Why Prediction Markets Got the Brazilian Election So Wrong
items.summary: Experts say Brazil's prediction market ban left the odds in the hands of traders with little knowledge about the election.

items.title: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
items.summary: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion chip deal with Apollo while lenders shut the door on smaller AI cloud firms, a split that could decide who controls computing.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
items.summary: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.

items.title: CZ pitches BNB Chain’s role in AI as BNB Standard rings Nasdaq bell
items.summary: CZ sees AI driving crypto use, while BNB Standard plans to expand beyond holding tokens in its treasury.

items.title: Hyperliquid says Kraken parent Payward to be first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer
items.summary: Hyperliquid plans to make Kraken parent Payward the first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer, a step toward regulated U.S. perpetual futures.

items.title: Y Combinator-backed Mochatrade raises $5.5 million to offer US stock perpetuals to Indian traders
items.summary: The platform is in beta and plans to open to the public in the coming weeks, co-founder Chetan Manda told The Block.

items.title: Prediction markets and derivatives drive Bernstein’s crypto stock outlook for Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle
items.summary: Bernstein cuts Coinbase’s target while raising Circle’s as new products shift their earnings outlook.

items.title: NBA becomes third league to sign CFTC prediction market pact, taps Kalshi and Polymarket
items.summary: The CFTC and NBA have agreed to put in place standards to protect the integrity of the game when it comes to prediction markets.

items.title: Tom Lee insists ‘crypto bull market is underway’ as Bitmine adds 10,452 ETH
items.summary: The company's combined crypto, cash, marketable securities, and other investments totaled $15 billion as of Oct. 25.

items.title: Ripple connects XRP Ledger to a 22 billion investment giant while chasing the next wave of corporate money
items.summary: Ripple expanded its institutional reach Monday as Aviva added another tokenized fund share class to the XRP Ledger (XRPL). The British asset manager invested 50 million ($66 million) in a blockchain-based share class of its Sterling Liquidity Fund, bringing its combined investments across two XRP Ledger offerings to more than 86 million ($116 million).

items.title: Strategy makes record $205 million STRC buyback as Strive spends $511 million on Bitcoin
items.summary: Bitcoin treasury firms Strategy and Strive made record purchases last week, but directed their capital toward different assets. While Michael Saylor's Strategy intensified its preferred-stock buybacks, Strive accelerated its Bitcoin accumulation, highlighting diverging priorities.

items.title: Treasury dealers’ net bill holdings hit a two-year high as October 30 funding pressure nears
items.summary: FHLBNY’s October 23 update puts dealer financing capacity in focus ahead of October 30, while Bitcoin spillover remains conditional.

items.title: Circle gives its Bitcoin-backed token one balance across Ethereum and Arc
items.summary: Gateway gives cirBTC holders a shared balance, with advertised fast access after deposit finality and a separate seven-day fallback exit.

items.title: Bitcoin faces an inflation warning beneath steady US consumer sentiment
items.summary: Michigan’s new historical comparison finds elevated long-run expectations that could complicate easier financing conditions for Bitcoin.

items.title: BTCPay’s API key fix is merged, but its latest release still predates the patch
items.summary: The October 19 merge restricts broad store-scoped grants, while the latest listed release still predates the change.

items.title: Coinbase Institutional Co-CEO: Bitcoin’s “Second Wave” of Institutional Capital has Arrived
items.summary: Seven mega banks and asset managers are now allocating to Bitcoin, according to Coinbase Institutional.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Hovers Near $80,000 as Traders Await Fed Decision
items.summary: Bitcoin price hovers near $80,000 as traders wait on this week’s Fed decision amid mixed macro signals.

items.title: Strategy (MSTR) Pauses Bitcoin Buying and Spends $205 Million on Preferred Stock
items.summary: Strategy skipped bitcoin buys for the week of October 20 and instead spent $205 million repurchasing preferred shares.

items.title: Bitcoin’s Bear Market Is Over, Galaxy Says
items.summary: Galaxy Research says that bitcoin’s bear market ended at the June low.

items.title: South Korea Weighs Fourth Delay of Crypto Tax, With 2029 Start Tied to U.S. Data Sharing
items.summary: South Korea is weighing a fourth delay of its crypto gains tax, with a possible 2029 start date linked to U.S. data sharing.

items.title: Leon Wankum: The Insane Math Behind Bitcoin Demonetizing Real Estate
items.summary: Leon Wankum argues real estate's $300T+ monetary premium is vulnerable to Bitcoin as a superior store of value.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
items.summary: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

items.title: NBA joins pro sports leagues on CFTC prediction markets bandwagon while NFL balks
items.summary: The U.S. derivatives regulator, which has championed the arrival of prediction market firms such as Kalshi, has been gathering allied sports leagues.

items.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
items.summary: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

items.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
items.summary: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.

items.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
items.summary: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.

items.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
items.summary: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.
